name: get_object_motion_id

stack.evidence: func_001D6B88 resolves the top object ID with func_001EAB00 and replaces it with object offset 0x164

notes: func_00130788 copies the low 16-bit motion request at object offset 0x17C into offset 0x164, then func_00130098 maps that motion ID through the object's motion table before animation setup; the adjacent offsets 0x168 and 0x16C hold the resulting animation ID and frame. A missing object leaves the input value unchanged. All 47 JP calls pass direct object IDs 1 or 2, immediately store the result, and compare it against motion IDs or ranges.
